chosen.premise: Starmie’s core sends mysterious radio signals into space, possibly communicating with something out there.
chosen.hook: Why is Starmie broadcasting into outer space?
chosen.visualIdea: Show the core pulsing, radio waves leaving Earth, and an unanswered star-filled sky.
chosen.note: A concrete mystery: Starmie broadcasts radio signals into space and may be communicating with something. Multiple entries directly support the premise, and the signal-to-stars visual is exceptionally clear.

candidates.premise: Starmie swims by spinning its star-shaped body like a ship propeller while absorbing tiny plankton.
candidates.hook: Starmie doesn’t swim—it turns its whole body into a propeller.
candidates.visualIdea: Spin Starmie underwater like a propeller, with plankton visibly pulled toward its path.
candidates.note: This is a highly concrete biological mechanic unique to Starmie: its entire star-shaped body spins like a propeller while it absorbs plankton. Strongly supported and very animatable.

candidates.premise: Starmie’s core glows in seven colors, and people believe the changing light is communication.
candidates.hook: Starmie may be talking—but only in seven colors.
candidates.visualIdea: Animate Starmie’s core cycling through seven colors while signal waves and question marks appear.
candidates.note: The seven-color communication claim is specific, distinctly Starmie, and easy to animate. It is slightly less surprising than the space-signal angle because the glowing core is familiar Starmie lore.

candidates.premise: Starmie’s glowing core is called the gem of the sea and can become secret high-priced accessories.
candidates.hook: Starmie’s core is valuable enough to trade in secret.
candidates.visualIdea: Zoom from Starmie’s core to a sparkling jewel, then reveal a shadowy secret marketplace.
candidates.note: The secret high-priced accessory trade is genuinely surprising and well supported, but “smuggling” overstates the cited wording, which only says the accessories are traded in secret.

candidates.premise: No matter where it lives, Starmie’s body grows into a symmetrical geometric shape.
candidates.hook: Starmie’s shape stays perfectly geometric in any environment.
candidates.visualIdea: Place Starmie in contrasting environments and overlay matching symmetry lines on every body.
candidates.note: The claim that Starmie grows into a symmetrical geometric shape regardless of environment is distinctive and visual. “Perfectly” matching symmetry would be stronger than the research wording, which only says symmetrical geometric shape.

candidates.premise: A Water Stone transforms the single-type Staryu into the Water/Psychic Pokémon Starmie.
candidates.hook: One Water Stone gives Staryu an entirely new type.
candidates.visualIdea: Show Staryu touching a Water Stone, then burst into Starmie as the Psychic type appears.
candidates.note: The evolution and added Psychic typing are supported, but Water Stone transformations and type changes are not especially unique or surprising as an episode premise. “Entirely new type” is also slightly imprecise because Starmie retains Water.

rounds.request: None. The strongest alternative is propeller-plankton; a stronger angle would need an even sharper contradiction or measurable detail, such as connecting Starmie’s seven-color core directly to its space broadcasts without implying more than the Pokédex states.
